source: local older wiki; observations are not packet verification
findings: Power Spike damage and Leech Signet Energy can occur even when interruption is prevented. Do not gate every secondary effect on interrupt success.
Power Lock and Psychic Distraction disable even when interruption is prevented. Disable and interrupt are distinct mechanics.
Cry of Frustration requires selected target using a skill but its area interrupt also affects ordinary attacks.
Power Block excludes unrelated no-attribute and title skills from attribute-wide disabling.

skills.description: Concise description Elite Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled ( 1...10...12 seconds) and that skill is interrupted.
skills.notes: If Power Block interrupts a PvE-only skill or one without a linked attribute, only that skill will be disabled; the target will still be able to use other title-track or no attribute skills. Wastrel's Worry and Wastrel's Demise are good sources of unconditional damage during the period that Power Block disables skills, especially against single-attribute builds (e.g. nukers ). Power Block will extend the recharge time of skills with a shorter disable/recharge time (skills with a longer downtime will not be affected). Disables skills even if interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted and take 15...63...75 damage.
skills.notes: The interrupt effect that is applied as an area of effect affects all actions (including basic attacks ) and occurs even if the interrupt on the initial target was prevented . Useful for interrupting a clumped group of spikers . In hard mode , multiple copies of this skill in the hands of foes can decimate an unsuspecting party in seconds. Especially parties of heroes and/or henchmen are at risk, due to their default formation being very close to one another. Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: interrupted spell or chant is disabled for + 5...11...13 seconds.
skills.notes: Disables skills even if interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: disables interrupted skill (+ 5...11...12 seconds). Your other skills are disabled (8 seconds).
skills.notes: Psychic Distraction has the fastest recharge time of all interrupt skills in the game. This skill bypasses anti-interruption skills such as Mantra of Resolve , as the skill will still be disabled and so will not complete casting.

skills.description: Concise description Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: deals 30...102...120 damage.
skills.notes: Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Signet. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: you gain 3...13...15 Energy if the action was a spell.
skills.notes: Grants energy even if the interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: you gain 1...25...31 Energy.
skills.notes: Grants energy even if the interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: causes 3...14...17 Energy loss.
skills.notes: Energy loss will still occur on a target even if the interruption effect is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: target foe gains 10...6...5 Energy.
skills.notes: Gives energy to a target even if the interruption effect is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Signet. Interrupts a spell. Can interrupt any skill if target foe is hexed. Interruption effect: deals 10...43...51 damage.
skills.notes: Has good synergy when interrupting a foe hexed by Frustration . Damage is done even if interruption is prevented.

skills.description: Concise description Stance. ( 30...78...90 seconds.) Prevents interrupts against you. Prevention cost: lose 10...5...4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.
skills.notes: When Mantra of Resolve successfully prevents an interrupt, it removes the set amount of energy; however, if the character does not have enough energy for removal, Mantra of Resolve will still prevent one interruption, then it will finally end. This also applies to Distortion . Does not work against interrupts that recharge the affected spell, e.g. it does not prevent Power Block .

skills.description: Concise description Stance. ( 1...31...38 seconds.) The next time you would be interrupted, you are not interrupted.

post_baseline_antibot_rule.behavior: Interrupt success odds increase with prior target-selection duration, up to approximately a quarter second depending on latency.
post_baseline_antibot_rule.baseline_decision: This update postdates the pinned2022 baseline; no universal minimum reaction-time rule is inferred or enabled.
post_baseline_antibot_rule.limits: Exact probability curve and latency adjustment are not documented by these notes.
